title: Thandege Thakka Maga
desc: Sathya is forced to marry a woman from a lower caste after his father's sudden death. He struggles to lead a happy marital life while dealing with certain problems.

title: Gandana Mane
desc: Gauri, a woman from a rich family, falls in love with Raja, a man who makes ends meet as a bus conductor.

title: Damayanthi
desc: A young man struggles to pay off his father's debts and decides to visit his family's abandoned bungalow. However, he soon realises that it is haunted by a vengeful ghost.

title: Rakshasudu
desc: After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.

title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.
